CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMACCOUNT] AS
BEGIN


WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CustomerAccountBalance_LNS AS (
SELECT 
	MAX(Timestamp) AS Timestamp
	,CustomerAccountId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BalancetypeId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
	WHERE BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BalancetypeId
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT
AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
, * from ( 
    SELECT DISTINCT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS')
 

UNION ALL

--FOR TRU RECORDS FILTER
SELECT 
 BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAS.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUSTYPEID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
GROUP BY 
BCA.CustomerAccountId
,BCA.CustomerAccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID
,BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
,DDB.BankSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId
UNION ALL

--FOR DEP RECORDS FILTER
SELECT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
--,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') 
     THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN  BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     END AS AccountStatus 
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAS.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUSTYPEID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.DepositAccountStatus BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')

UNION ALL

-- FOR LNS RECORDS FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT
	BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
	,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
	,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
	,CASE
		WHEN BCCA.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA') AND BCAB.BalanceAmount = 0 
		THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'Active' END AS AccountStatus
	,CASE 
		 WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCAP.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
		 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
	,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
	,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
	,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BCAB.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountBalance_LNS BCABL ON BCAB.Timestamp = BCABL.Timestamp AND BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCABL.CustomerAccountId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = BCABL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAB.BalancetypeId = BCABL.BalancetypeId
WHERE BCAB.BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount' ) BCAB ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAF ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAF.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCAP ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCAP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'

) A 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountID
    ,AccountName
    ,AccountOpenedDate
    ,AccountStatus
    ,PayrollIndicator
    ,CurrencyCode
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     AccountID
    ,AccountName
    ,AccountOpenedDate
    ,AccountStatus
    ,PayrollIndicator
    ,CurrencyCode
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN  TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR ( TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT SRC ON  SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DIMACCOUNT
(
 AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
